glass_stalkers.title: Glass Stalkers
glass_stalkers.description: Two lean shapes pace the caravan track, their hides crusted with splinters of glass.

shard_raiders.title: Shard Raiders
shard_raiders.description: A bandit chief and two raiders step out from behind a glass outcrop, blades wrapped against the glare.

shimmer_storm.title: The Shimmer Storm
shimmer_storm.description: The horizon folds into a wall of white light. There is no shelter on the open Flats, only the long run through the glare.

objective.description: Hold the Glass Flats until the shimmer passes.
objective.success: The shimmer passes. The road shines clean again.
objective.failure: The storm drives you back toward camp.

hazards.name: Shimmer Wind
hazards.description: The heat turns the air to knives.

shard_ambush.title: Nim's Watch
shard_ambush.description: Raiders close in while Nim is exposed on the ridge. Keep her on her feet until the caravan horn answers.

objective.description: Keep Nim alive until the caravan horn answers.
objective.success: Nim drops down beside you, breathing hard.
objective.failure: Nim falls, and the raiders close over the ridge.

mirror_warden.title: The Mirror Warden
mirror_warden.description: A figure of black glass unfolds beneath the observatory dome, flanked by echoes that wear Renn's face.

objective.description: Break the Mirror Warden before the echoes drag you down.
objective.success: The Mirror Warden shatters; the echoes lose their shape.
objective.failure: The Warden turns the Sun Lens on the caravan road.

hazards.name: Prism Flash
hazards.description: The mirrors throw the desert sun across the dome.

collapsing_vault.title: The Falling Dome
collapsing_vault.description: The observatory groans as the mirrors crack. The exit is behind you, and the echoes are between.

objective.description: Survive the falling glass and escape the observatory.
objective.success: You reach the Flats as the dome comes down behind you.
objective.failure: The falling dome seals the observatory.

hazards.name: Falling Glass
hazards.description: The mirrors come down in sheets.
